skill_name: What techniques can I use for meditation?
workflow: Meditation is an effective tool for relaxation and stress relief. There are many techniques that can be used for meditation, such as mindfulness meditation, body scan meditation, loving-kindness meditation, breathing meditation, and visualization meditation. Mindfulness meditation focuses on the present moment—in this technique, you pay attention to what is happening in the present moment without judgment. Body scan meditation starts with paying attention to the physical sensations and feelings
